entities.name: First Crusade
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Military expedition (1096–1099) called by Pope Urban II to recapture Jerusalem from Muslim rule. The Crusaders' capture of Jerusalem established Crusader states in the Levant and inaugurated two centuries of religious warfare.
